notes.title: Update 6 : New Achievements, Weapon, and Boss!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Survival Typists![/b][/p][p]We’re back with another update packed with content, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements. Let’s jump right into it![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Weapon: Orbiter[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/2408213a03f42da41abd44494be99ad011eed0e0.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Orbiter brings a fresh twist to the battlefield. When you type words starting with specific letters, it spawns orbs that rotate around your main weapon, dealing chemical damage to everything they pass through. Evolve it to deal electric damage, send out twin orbs in opposite directions, or form a damaging tether between the main weapon and the orb for some truly chaotic typing action.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Boss: Gemini[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/01e59071ce4220b91476486d230916e9d455dbc1.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Gemini isn’t a single boss. It’s two. Damaging only one won’t get you far, because they constantly heal each other to the highest health between them. You’ll need to split your focus and keep your damage even. And when they unleash their Tendril attack? Get ready to mash your keys or buttons fast![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Achievements[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/ca91811e8c6c9968ca4a66a4fdb20c8f752ff77d.gif"][/img][/p][p]We heard your feedback. More achievements, please! This update adds a fresh batch, including simpler ones for new players and tough-as-nails challenges for our veteran typists. There’s something for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Evolutions for Chopper[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/1883f717128e5f82ed098c7caaed483fec4c774e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Chopper gets two new ways to shred:
[i]Saw Launcher[/i] turns the Chopper into a barrage of smaller saw-blades.
[i]Bloodbath[/i] adds bonus damage to bleeding enemies and raises their double damage drop chance.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Audio Themes[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="FxTeYlRQsdk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]You can now groove to two new music sets: [i]Sunset[/i] is a laid-back, beachy lounge track for mellow vibes. [i]Midnight[/i] is a lo-fi, head-nodding beat for focused destruction. Both pair beautifully with their visual theme counterparts, and you can swap them in the settings anytime.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Less Grind, More Game[/b][/h2][p]Let’s be honest. We let the economy get a bit out of hand. So we’re fixing that. Coin drops have been doubled across the board, and all main weapons now cost a flat 1000 coins to unlock. No more grind. Just more typing, more fun.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]2 New Augment Codices[/b][/h2][p]Electric and Heat Augment Codices are now available. These unlock even more creative and dangerous build possibilities. Perfect for chasing those new achievements and wreaking havoc with elemental synergies.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for this update, folks! We hope you enjoy the new weapons, bosses, tunes, and quality-of-life changes. As always, we’ll be back again in 2 months with even more content and features to keep your fingers flying.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][p]- Added auto-correct when Capslock is on for Korean input.[/p][p]- Fixed Guardian chases Jormungander endlessly.[/p][p]- Changed "Loot Weapons" in localization to "Loot Effects" to be in line with nomenclature.[/p][p]- Updated affected weapons section in loot screen for more accuracy.[/p][p]- Fixed Scapegoat not using correct SFX (now you can hear our bleats!)[/p][p]- Fixed loot items affecting chances (drop chance, crit chance, etc) not showing up.[/p][p]- Reverted to old way of generating Cypher strings because the new way was causing crashes.[/p][p]- Fixed null reference crash in enemy Armor script.[/p][p]- Fixed some unusable loot items generated due to missing stat in requirements.[/p][p]- Fixed reroll and shield chance bonuses missing from Run Information breakdown.[/p][p]- Fixed crash due to variable misnaming in loot screen.[/p][p]- Fixed crash when loading game with missing or renamed upgrade.[/p][p]- Fixed wrong number printed in loot description for Release.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][p]- Added new lane management so reduced word overlapping (not entirely eliminated though)[/p][p]- Caltrops: Increased base Bleed Chance + Bleed Chance scale with Caltrops damage.[/p][p]- Reduced consumable item loot weight.[/p][p]- Changed Warhead tag from "Loot" to "Consumable"[/p][p]- Added Duration stat level-up upgrades for Guardian.[/p][p]- Added "Augment" tag for Augment Effects.[/p][p]- Increased Guardian fuel pickup from 50% to 60% refill.[/p][p]- Increased SplatterShot Puddle Damage over time by 25%.[/p][p]- Made all Main Weapons cost 1000 coins and doubled coin drop rate.[/p][p]- Made at least one choice during level up an upgrade by default. No longer requires Devotion Augment.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][p]- New Electric Augment Codex.[/p][p]- New Heat Augment Codex.[/p][p]- Added Sunset audio theme.[/p][p]- Added Midnight audio theme.[/p][p]- Added new level-up weapon Orbiter.[/p][p]- Added new Trial 1 boss: Gemini.[/p][p]- Added "Bloodbath" and "Saw Launcher" evolutions for Chopper.[/p][p]- New Achievements added.[/p][p]- Added Chemical, Loot and Augment related loot items.[/p][p][/p][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][p]- Updated Seismic Munition II's description for more clarity.[/p][p]- Renamed Juryrigged to Makeshift due to it sounding similar to Jerry-rigged.[/p][p]- "Double Damage Chance" changed to "Double Damage Drop Chance" for more clarity.[/p]

notes.title: Glyphica : Update 5 Brings new weapon, boss, consumable loot and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Survival Typists!

We’re back with our regular updates, creating more content for you to enjoy, as well as some cosmetic experiments. Let’s get right to it!

[h3]New Weapon : Guardian[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/e82a750f09dfde8ba44c3c9863e530be33e0cd22.gif[/img]
The Guardian is a self propelled persistent Drone that guards the main turret with melee orbiting heat attacks. While it is a very powerful automated weapon, you need to keep picking up fuel to keep it going!

[h3]New Boss : Jormungandr[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/03ba34a82d92c437ccb60aa8817681f34a3e0495.gif[/img]
Last update we drew from Greek mythology, this time we take a nod to Norse mythology. Jörmungandr was a mythological creature who supposedly encircled the world, biting its own tail. One of the signals that the end of the world is coming is when the serpent finally lets go of its tail to wreak havoc on the world. Our version of the serpent circles your main weapon menacingly while releasing single letter projectiles for you to shoot down. 

[h3]Consumable Loot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/c68a037966a7f3143bb86603bcb016c7b5829d24.gif[/img]
We’ve added a new consumables system to the game to allow you to store items in an inventory and then use them at will by typing the corresponding word. For example, the “Warhead” consumable triggers a massive string of explosions to take out enemies close to the main weapon. Right now all consumables are obtained via the Loot system, but we’re working to expand this and create more consumables in future updates.

[h3]Cosmetic Updates[/h3]
We’re slowly rolling out cosmetic updates like letting you change the music and color scheme to the game. This is more complex than we thought it would be, and we need more time to implement it fully. However, we did want to give you all a sneak peek of how it would work. In the audio settings, you can now choose between Glyphica’s current music set and the original music it launched with back in the 2024 Next Fest. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/e7635919d8e739626b7333606c5e00a42d682a9b.gif[/img]
In addition, we’ve added a couple of new color themes aside from our light and dark themes. We will slowly open this up so more players can take advantage of this and make their own color themes, but if you have any theme requests let us know!

[h3]Combo Weapon Evolutions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/91f94d0ed1a12a2fded1d481f20b4148d7c44167.gif[/img]
We’ve added more weapon Evolutions to the Minefield to increase the variations of gameplay. But on top of that, we’re excited to add weapon evolutions that only happen if you are using two specific weapons. The Dirty Bomb evolution makes your mines shoot puddles of goo when they explode, but you can only use this evolution if you are using Splattershot as well. We want future combos like this to be a cool surprise for players, but we’re leaking this one for you all to enjoy.

[h3]Omen Update[/h3]
There were players who didn't want the weapons kept from growing due to the Omen II penalty. We've updated the omen system and replaced the penalty with a new 9-letter wordlist.

[h3]Localized Achievements[/h3]

Achievements are now localized so you can all challenge yourselves to be better typists!

[h3]Outro[/h3]
That’s it for this update folks! We hope you enjoy this update, and we will be back again in 2 months to give you some fresh new content and features!

CHANGELOG

--------

notes.title: Update 4 : New Main Weapon, Evolutions, and Boss!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pIE7eIjZr0U;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Survival Typists!

This update brings a lot of new content for you to play with. Since we know a lot of you have been impatient for the new stuff, let’s get right down to it!

[h3]New Main Weapon : Splatter Shot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/51cb1b9b66913f2493d8730e2052df2e795c980b.gif[/img]
Splatter Shot introduces a different weapon and play style for our survival typists. Spit out nasty goo at your enemies to slow them down and deal D.O.T. while your other weapons finish them off. Evolutions allow you to change the damage type according to your build preference or gives you options to expand the spread of the goo.

[h3]Weapon Evolutions…Evolved![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/1912baa45ee7e7f2bcdee918a5301ad189f67578.gif[/img]
We’re also planning to add more weapon evolutions to our current weapon set to give you even more opportunities to discover new weapon synergies. Repeater and Heat Ray are getting evolutionary updates this time around, like Exploding Bullets for Repeater. 

[h3]New Boss : Cerberus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/c6173b5c3ce6e5b2f2b0bec98aea71aa30788e0f.gif[/img]
Like the 3 headed creature from Greek mythology, this boss has 3 heads that relentlessly shoot enemies at you. We made this boss especially for the speed typers to have a lot of words to type in rapid succession!

Like some of our other bosses, Cerberus has a final form that comes back to haunt you later in the game. But we’ll keep that a secret for now…

[h3]Outro[/h3]
That’s it for this update folks! We hope you enjoy this update, and we will be back again in 2 months to give you some fresh new content and features!

CHANGELOG
BALANCING
---------
- Added Low Loot mode, which recycles some filler loot when the loot pool runs dry.
- Reverted Pinata to +2% loot chance.
- Added "Loot" tag to Frostbite.
- Lowered Ice Rain and Ice Rain II freeze chance to 5% and +5% respectively.
- Added unique loot for out-of-loot situations (instead of recycling filler loot) that is less abusable.
- Changed Slime Bubble evolution of Splatter Shot to do splash damage on top of creating more Splatter Zones.
- Changed Slime Bubble II evolution to give Slime Bubbles 50% chance to auto-activate on expiry instead of doing more damage on zone overlaps.
- Removed zone overlaps (all Splatter Shot Splatter Zones are now on the same layer)
- Changed Compounder evolution of Splatter Shot to Virulence, which shortens duration of Splatter Zones, but make them expand over time.
- SplatterShot Virulence Evolution duration decrease changed from -30% multiplicative to -50% additive.
- Seer loot item now gives you a free reroll if you enter level-up, evolution or loot screen with zero rerolls.
- Fracture loot item now gives you +50% damage to frozen enemies.
- Limited Range upgrades to Meteor once it has reached +100% range.
- Increased HP of Cerberus by 40%. Projectile health remains the same for now.
- Make Cerberus move on 25% damage mark to any head.
- Updated localization files for all offically supported languages.

BUGFIXES
--------
- Added missing UI for Splatter Shot (HP, Shields, etc)
- Fix Static weapon crash for Tesla Restricted Area II during load game.
- Fixed inconsistent pickup removal on trial complete and game end.
- Fixed crash due to sound driver not found.
- Fixed SplatterShot VFX not clearing on game end.
- Fixed word offset (distance between word and enemy/pickup) not respecting current resolution.
- Fixed Main Weapon not affected by Augments until first upgrade.
- Fixed changing option categories has no audio feedback.
- Fixed SplatterShot Virulence evolution duration decrease not reflected in Run Information screen.
- Fixed global Status Effect Chance modifiers not shown in Run Information screen.
- Fixed wrong numbers for SplatterShot range upgrades.
- Fixed audio settings not being loaded.
- Spliter shards now respect resolution scaling.
- Stopped Cerberus from firing at the player during movement.
- Make weapons respect Armor at the center of Cerberus.
- Fixed Harmonizer giving incorrect Evolutions on game load.
- Fixed crash when using Dark Relay on Cerberus.
- Fixed wrong hiragana on some Japanese words in wordlist.
- Updated naming of Lava II Splattershot Evolution to use Roman numerals instead of Arabic.
- Fixed Simplified Chinese localization for "Double-Bladed" Heat Ray Evolution.
- Fixed Blaster evolution for Heat Ray does not respect pause.

FEATURES
--------

- Added new sound effects for SplatterShot.

- Make Cerberus move on 25% damage mark to any head.

notes.title: Glyphica Roadmap Update and Update 4 Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
Hello Survival Typists,

We want to send a big thank you to all our players. Glyphica has over 35,000 players now, with a rating of 88% positive on Steam. With your help, we’re excited to keep working more on the game to reach even more people.

[h3]New Development Schedule[/h3]
At the start of Early Access we wanted to release monthly updates in order to reassure players of our commitment to the game. This kind of development schedule is difficult for us to maintain, especially when unforeseen circumstances arise. Therefore starting with Update 4, our update schedule will be every every 2 months, and our target release for Update 4 will be at the end of March.

[h3]Update 4 Sneak Preview on Staging Branch[/h3]
However, we want to remind anyone that wants a sneak preview of what we are working on that this will always be available on our staging branch:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2400160/discussions/9/4694532371788122596/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/51cb1b9b66913f2493d8730e2052df2e795c980b.gif[/img]
For example if you access the staging branch now, you’ll get a first look at our Splatter Shot Main Weapon, which will be released in Update 4.

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
With that, we’d like to update the previous roadmap we shared by going through what was added to the game already as well as showing you what else we have planned for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/1e7323bf5b9554929538f2903b9436cb943616c7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Glyphica : Typing Survival Early Access Update 3
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=o00bxvrM0qs;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Survival Typists! 

This update does bring long term improvements and additions to the game that improve the experience for both old and new players alike.  Statistics and Leaderboards were one of our roadmap promises, and they are the focus of our update this time!

[h3]Stat Tracking[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/2690c52a845bf9f53ef023e8477e10edba0f2fff.gif[/img]
We know that a lot of you like keeping track of your stats in the game and seeing how you are improving over time. For each main weapon, if you do an endless run, we will track your latest 10 playthroughs and track your WPM and accuracy. This is our first iteration of statistics in the game. So if you guys have more things that you would like to track, please do let us know in the comments!

[h3]Friend Leaderboards[/h3]
While the game is not built for competitive play, we know that a lot of you wanted to see how you stack up against your friends. In the leaderboard we take different stats like the time survived and difficulty level to give you a score, which is then used to rank you.

Each leaderboard is unique to a main weapon, which gives you a chance to beat your friends depending on which weapon is your main. In future updates we plan to add global leaderboards as well.

[h3]Run Information[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/ec29d0959bc6fc32b665c158ffbf4d6846b254e6.gif[/img]
Previously during a run we only showed you weapon information. Due to popular demand, we have added more information for you to better strategize your present and future runs.

You can now select between different tabs in the Run Information screen to show which loot you’ve picked up and which augments you have selected for this Run. If there is any other information you want here, please let us know and we’ll work on adding them!

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]
We've improved the UI updating loop to be much more efficient, which yielded overall performance gains throughout the game. Now that has been fixed and we’re expecting you to have a much smoother game experience overall!

[h3]Loot Rework[/h3]
Our loot has been neglected for a long time and we did a major rebalancing of the items pickups to better fit the current game meta. Some loot has been nerfed, and some have had more gradations added to them to fill in some gaps.  

[h3]Options Menu Organization[/h3]
Another relatively small but meaningful update is a reorganizing of our options menu into different tabs. Why is this meaningful? Because it’s an important and necessary step for adding things like custom color themes and fonts into the game!

[h3]Wiki Localization[/h3]
We added an official wiki in one of our recent updates, and have now updated it with more localized content!

[h3]Future Plans[/h3]
And that’s all for Update 3. We hope you enjoy these updates! In the meantime, we’ll get back to work and bring you another update at the end of next month.

CHANGELOG

BUGFIXES
--------
- Fixed rarity icon not scaling based on resolution.
- Fixed Barrage explosion radius not scaling based on resolution.
- Fixed French Poet passage that gets stuck at last character (there was a rogue newline that was removed)
- Filter Cypher scrambled words against a blacklist.
- Added "ss" as a fallback for "ß"
- Stop spawning enemies behind Poet UI.
- Made Meteor pickups spawn at more reasonable positions.
- Fixed garbled screen for Steam Deck during bootup.
- Fixed sometimes letters are detected as mistypes even if they are not.

notes.title: Glyphica : Typing Survival Early Access Update 2.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/602ca7dce45f85501dbf1f48baedc79a86c449c6.gif[/img]
Happy Holidays, Survival Typists!

We said we wouldn’t be back with an update until January but we could not resist leaving a little christmas present for you all. This mini update brings balance changes and the ability to choose a specific wordlist language of your choice!

[h3]Independent Wordlists[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/baa319083655290941e7855cb7474d7eb2048275.gif[/img]
Word lists are now independent of the UI language you have chosen! What this means is you can now have your UI in English and your wordlist in Japanese or vice versa. This is the first step in eventually letting you folks more easily add custom wordlists to the game.

[h3]Holiday Wordlist[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/56ffffeb131a9e4fdc2d0820d6bd6cc4476dab1e.png[/img]
[i]Not gonna lie, the poet music combined with "Joy to the world" feels super sinister.[/i]

Since it’s the holiday season, we thought the perfect way to celebrate would be a themed wordlist! With help from our community we cobbled together this holiday wordlist with words from as many different languages and traditions as we had on our discord server. Please note that this wordlist is incredibly unbalanced, so as we might say in the Philippines, “Play for fun, not for prizes!”

[h3]Difficulty Balancing[/h3]
We hear the consistent concerns regarding the difficulty of the early stages of the game, so we’ve made a few changes to the game that hopefully address the situation.

[h3]Improved English Wordlist (more common words and more two handed words)[/h3]
Some of our players have voiced concerns that the wordlist we use has a lot of uncommon words that make the mental load of typing much more difficult than it needs to be. We’ve also taken the step of specifically adding more two handed words for an easier typing experience especially at the beginning levels. Hopefully this overall brings an improved typing experience for players of all skill levels.

If you feel your non-English language also has similar issues in the game, please let us know and we will do what we can to improve the wordlists there as well.

[h3]Enemy Speed and Spawning Behavior[/h3]
We’ve also globally lowered the speed of the randomly fast enemies that pop up in the game, as well as making some spawning changes in the code that SHOULD prevent the sudden spawning of hordes of enemies all at the same time, which is not intended.

With that, we'll bid a happy holidays to those that celebrate, and we'll see you again in the new year!

CHANGELOG

BALANCING
-------------
- Lowered speed of fast enemies.
- Added minimum cooldown between enemy spawns.
- Updated English wordlist

FEATURES
-----------
- Separated UI and typing language.
- Added holiday wordlist
- Added holiday menu effect (it's snowing in Glyphica!)

Hello Survival Typists! 

We’re back sooner than expected, with a much smaller update this time around.

[h3]Balancing and Late Game Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/9cab14b870c4fff25fd27ab82ebb0befa3b7153f.gif[/img]
We are honestly are shocked at how many of you are getting so far into the game, reaching level 1000+ in some cases. This was never our intention, so we’ve made some balancing changes to the game like stronger enemies that should make the late game more challenging.

[h3]Word Rush Bonus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/fdcca7c4951fc1a4d9104243df907cd5679aea0d.gif[/img]
We wanted to reward fast typers, so we added a word rush bonus so that they can take advantage of their fast typing skills. 

We also added a fix for when fast typers type an enemy word that has been killed by another weapon. We now delay the disappearance of that enemy to allow you to continue typing seamlessly.

[h3]New Enemy : Splitter[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/fc239ff131a80b633ffc643992639e8a13ea6b42.gif[/img]
This update brings a new enemy to torment you! The splitter acts like a regular drone, but the secret is once you destroy it, it splits into…more drones! Make sure you deal with a Splitter before it gets too close because you might suddenly have more enemies than you can deal with.

The relaxed difficulty of the game is now even more relaxed, to give new players a chance to get used to the game mechanics before moving on to more difficult challenges.

We’re updating this over time with suggestions from the community, but till then, the subjects of the King can get cosy in their pyjamas, have a cuppa, and type to survive!

notes.title: Glyphica : Typing Survival Early Access Update 1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DCwo-PD3Aeg;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Survival Typists! 

As promised we are bringing you the first of our planned monthly updates. Update 1 brings you Augmentations, a new weapon, and a host of other small additions and improvements.

But first, we want to thank everyone who has bought the game so far. Glyphica has sold over 17,000 copies so far, with an 85% positive rating. We appreciate all the feedback so far, both good and bad. Now, on the update!

[h3]Augmentations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/d84c5db2a7ce1e44da6431c14911bf14fd15a550.gif[/img]
The main event is Augmentations! Our trials get super hard as you advance, so we built the Augmentations system to complement them. As you play the game, you’ll now be able to pick up coins, which you then use to buy augments that you equip at the start of a play session.

For example, if you are super confident with your perfect input, choose the Immaculate Augmentation to improve your Crit chance. On the other hand if you make mistakes a lot, choose Scapegoat to automatically sacrifice a drone instead of losing your perfect input streak.

This is only the first batch of augmentations, and more will be added over time.

[h3]Barrage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/7f373b47f909fba9a89d3622c81bf4170e740ed2.gif[/img]
Update 1’s new main weapon is Barrage. Unleash a flurry of Robotech style missiles at your enemies to cause AoE damage. But it takes time to reload, so it will be a matter of skill and timing as to when you unleash your rockets. To unlock barrage you will need to have finished at least Omen 3 on one of the other main weapons.
Difficulty Settings

[h3]Easier Difficulties[/h3]
We’ve been reading the reviews and discussion on the forums and on Discord, and we know that some of you have been struggling with the difficulty of the game! So we’ve created two modes to ease you into Glyphica until you’re ready to take on our trials. Omens will not unlock and Achievements will be disabled when playing in either mode.

[b]Typist[/b]
Typist mode is the purest form of Glyphica. Type to shoot, and that’s it. No other weapons, no upgrades, no experience, just typing. Only basic drones will spawn, and while they will increase in word length they can be taken out with one shot. This is probably best for the person who wants to just practice their basic typing skills.

[b]Relaxed[/b]
Relaxed mode is basically like our normal mode, but with 50% less enemies to deal with. This is best for the person who is more confident with their typing now and wants to practice engaging with what the full game has to offer.

[h3]Spaces and Punctuation[/h3]
We initially removed the need to type punctuation and spaces for our Poet boss because during our playtests people we’re having a hard time with the game. But it turns out some of you really want a legitimate typing experience! So we went ahead and added an option to toggle spaces and punctuation (very original, I know) in the options menu.

[h3]Special Characters Fallback[/h3]
A lot of you were having trouble with special characters like ë or é in the game. And some of you just plain hated having to type with accented letters! Since we are dealing with so many possible different keyboard configurations, we made the decision to simplify everyone’s lives by making the game default to the “base” letter while playing the game. So for example if you see an é and freak out, don’t worry just type e.

[h3]Music[/h3]
[previewyoutube=VPILuoKTzIg;full][/previewyoutube]
Our talented sound partners at Imba Interactive are at it again, providing not only new sounds for the barrage weapons, but boss music as well! The Poet mixes classical music with a modern edge (think witcher + drum and bass), while the Cypher, as a sort of codebreaking kind of boss, takes its influence from morse code, of all things!

[h3]More Poetry[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/192b41e31f2b680b6f7853c1e54c1cb1d1bbd398.gif[/img]
We saw that some of you were getting bored of the Poet’s poetry (and we can’t blame you) so we’re slowly working on adding to his repertoire. Currently we’ve added some more poetry to the English, Spanish, and French versions. We are actually using public domain poetry for this, so if you have any suggestions for popular poetry in one of the languages that is in public domain, let us know!

That's it for now! We plan on another smaller update at the end of this month, so keep an eye out for that!

Changelog

BUGFIXES
--------
- Fixed unlocalized "Damage" string in weapon details.
- Fixed pickup boxes cropped on larger resolutions.
- Fixed crash on Omen select if you have beaten Omen VI.
- Show "All Trials Completed" when you beat Omen VI instead of Omen VII.
- Fixed Barrage pickups and ammo reload does not respect game pause.

- Fixed Pickup offset and box does not scale with resolution.
- Fixed Shield icon offset above main weapon does not scale with resolution.
- Fixed Barrage turret shape not scaling with resolution.
- Fixed Regeneration loot item not adding whole numbers to health.


BALANCING
--------
-Added Typist Mode.
-- Only basic drone spawns, but they increase in number and words increase in length faster.
-- No level ups, evolutions or loot.
-- No double damage or reroll drops. Freeze and Shield remain.
-Added Relaxed Mode.
-- Game plays as normal but 50% enemy threat increase (reduces amount of all enemy types)
-No Omen unlocks when playing on Typing and Relaxed mode.
-Achievements disabled on Typist and Relaxed mode.
- Added 2 additional pages of Augments

FEATURES
--------
- Added boss music for Poet and Cypher bosses.
- Added Barrage main turret (no audio yet and rough balance)
- Added reworked Augment system and one page of Augments. (More coming tomorrow)
- Re-added Coin pickups and adjusted amount to take into account Trial and Omen.

notes.title: Final Demo Update and Localization Tools : Build 2024.07.14-001-ALPHA
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/8b2e50d846c2bcd4998fa7b198e91419434ea9f9.png[/img]
Hello survival typists,

We're coming to you with our final update to the Glyphica demo today. Once again we want to thank you all for playing the game, joining our Discord, and giving us feedback. You've helped us make the game so much better, and most of those changes have foud their way into the demo.

However as we raised in the previous announcement, the demo will stop being updated as some point as we focus our attention on the Early Access build of the game. We have reached that point now. This will be the last update of the demo, with the exception of any patches to fix game breaking bugs. 

[h3]Progress will not be Transferrable[/h3]
Please be aware that your progress in the demo will not be transferrable to the Early Access version of the game. The Early Access version of the game adds mechanics and changes systems in a way that will make progress non transferrable. We know that this may be frustrating to some of you, but we hope that you understand and appreciate the demo regardless and look forward to our additions in the Early Access build.

[h3]Language Experimentation[/h3]
Glyphica has been designed in a way that weapon choices are meaningful, many of them being triggered by the first letter of a word. While this makes the game much more strategic than your average typing game, it does mean we can’t simply throw in a wordlist in your language and expect it to work.

For Early Access our current focus is to release with Japanese language included, since we have so many fans from Japan already. But for other languages we will be testing them first before adding official localization during the Early Access process. In the future we also plan to add mod support so that you can share your own wordlists with other players.

But in the meantime we don’t want to leave you hanging. We already have some built in tools that we are using to test out different languages. If you want to play with them in the demo, we have prepared a guide for you to do that:

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1G66Pz9a-cce7v5UXsSoJhCPrsiWe4IRhtg4fZIgM_kg/edit]Glyphica Localization Process[/url]
While you cannot share your wordlists as a mod just yet, you should be able to share .jsonc files with other players using your same language.

[h3]Events Schedule[/h3]

Our lead dev XM will be taking Glyphica on the road very soon, bringing with him the latest version of the game:
[url=https://bitsummit.org/]Bitsummit in Kyoto[/url]
[url=https://bicfest.org/]BICFest in Busan[/url] 
If you happen to be around, drop by to say hello and give the latest version of the game a spin.

That's all for now, typists, we'll be back with more news soon!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
Bug Fixes
- Fixed bug where Giant Magnet accelerated Meteor pickup cooldowns.
- Fixed "getHit" crash for projectile-based weapons (Repeater, Sentry & Oscillator)
- Fixed game screen getting cut-off for screens smaller than 1080p.
- Fixed bug when canceling the quit confirm prompt freezes the UI.

Balancing
- Improved Japanese wordlist.
- Complete Japanese localization.
- Moved health bar to a more noticeable location.
- Changed "Return to Main Menu" in pause menu to "Surrender" so you can see your summary.

notes.title: New Update Brings New Enemy and New Weapon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/3602cf85769242aee9c4a30ad194d5f2f0f421bc.png[/img]

Hello Survival Typists,

We put a lot of work into a new mission/campaign system this week, but since XM is going on a well deserved vacation and the features were simply too new and buggy, we decided on a smaller, safer update this week. But that doesn't mean we'll leave you hanging with this update, which brings a sneaky new enemy and a new weapon from on high!

[h2]Stalker Enemy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/7ef2c60c4bd73c3ff4e370680561e295e6957146.gif[/img]
This sneaky enemy will only reveal one letter at a time, creating a very stressful situation! Let us know in the comments how you feel about this enemy.

[h2]Meteor Weapon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/a0600a317483bb6bc896bddc09aba16b05562c41.gif[/img]
We're removing the Firestorm weapon for some tweaking, so in its place we've added the meteor weapon, which selects a random area on the map and lets you rain literal hellfire on that area.

That's on top of all the other fixes and balancing we've done to the game over the past few weeks. Thanks again to everyone who has joined our discord and folks submitting feedback and bugs in our online form, we couldn't have done this without you!

Full Changelog Below:

Bugfixes
--------
- Fixed armor detection in explosions.
- Drones will properly prioritize targets now.
- Fixed "Freeze" and "Double Damage" text effects not showing up in non-english localizations.
- Fixed enemies spawning without hitboxes in late game.
- Made 2x Damage multiplicative instead of additive.
- Fixed Glass Cannon halving current health as well.
- Blocked Warlike from spawning if Frostbite has been picked previously.
- Fixed Sentry damage upgrades having the same name for Common, Uncommon and Rare variants.
- Fixed Refrigerant and Vulnerability loot items description not reflecting actual effect.

Balancing
---------
- Increased health for Shooters, Warder and Swarmer's children by 50%
- Removed Slashing and Rapidfire tags, having less tags create more synergy between weapons.
- Make Shooter projectiles give more warning, have a larger hitbox and more health. Making them more dangerous.
- Make Shield Drones have more shield than health.
- Added 3rd tier of Shield Drones that spawns in late game.
- Removed Firestorm temporarily for re-design.
- Removed 10-min difficulty ramp from "Relaxed" difficulty.

Features
--------
- Added Stalker enemy that reveals word one letter at a time.
- Added Bleeding status effect. Inflicted by Chopper after upgrade and does Kinetic damage over time.
- Added Static status effect. Inflicted by Tesla Mines after upgrade. Does Energy damage over time and also damages nearby enemies.
- Added new weapon, Meteor. Spawns markers for orbital bombardment in random locations. When marker is activated, pelt area surrounding marker with explosions for several seconds.

Misc.
-----
- New visuals for Warder, Spawner and Shooter projectiles.

notes.title: New Wordlist and UI : Update v2024.05.03.001-ALPHA
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/118d2b21141df7306bb06dd351f6f0ce2a3c6677.gif[/img]
Hello Survival Typists!

Thanks to your feedback, we are hard at work pushing out regular updates to the game, seeking to find the right balance before moving on to new features. A new UI gives you a clearer view of your current weapon set, and new word lists have been added for more variety and balancing.

A quick note on word lists! Glyphica's weapons are actually quite strategic in that they are triggered by the first letter of a word. This adds a lot more strategic choice making to the game, but does also mean that it's not super simple to simply download a wordlist and go hog wild without severly unbalancing the game. This also means it is a little more complex to add languages to the game, but we are definitely exploring different languages down the pipeline.

Keep those bug reports and feedback coming, and see you in the next update!

Bugfixes
- Fixed crash due to Spectre doing damage calculations when hitting Warder armor.
- Fixed late-game spawner malfunction and spawning very little enemies.
- Fixed words sometimes cut short.
- Fixed augments can't be purchased if coins equal the cost of augment.
- Fixed pickups spawning on screen edge, causing word to not be wholly visible.
- Fixed crash due to running out of upgrades.

Balancing
- Nerfed Spectre and Hunter damage.
- Balancing pass due to upgrade rarity and overall lowered upgrade stat increases.
- Lowered damage from enemies so you don't die in a few hits.
- Reduced Warder shielding range.
- Updated wordlist with a LOT more words.

Features
- Words now fade out when overlapping, showing only the word of enemy closest to player.
- Added upgrade rarity and variation in stat increase.
- Added weapon bar at bottom of screen to track current weapons and upgrade counts.
- Added health bar and health number at bottom of screen.

notes.title: Update v2024.04.26.001-ALPHA adds Flow Improvements and Japanese Localization
notes.notes:
Hello Survival Typists! 

As a sign of our commitment to releasing updates for this game, here's the first patch for the Glyphica demo. These patches will come as needed, but over time we want to have a regularly scheduled major update alongside these smaller patches so that you all have something to look forward to as the game develops.

[h2]Flow Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/2be8d093b4858889848568bb73f1bbd560606535.gif[/img]
There is a changelog below, but the biggest changes are that you can now level up when you like by pressing the spacebar or right stick down on the controller. It's a small quality of life feature but really helps the game flow better and make you feel like you are in control. In addition to that, you can now pause the game by pressing escape or the menu button on the controller, so you can take a break and rest your hands when you are at level 50 (which if you've reached it, is much higher than I ever have.)

[h2]Japanese Localization Experiment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862715/637fb7670c7a6a8f9798a6a38f21e25ccf14ec99.gif[/img]
In addition to that, we have also experimented with adding Japanese localization. Localization is trickier than you might expect for the game, as the design of the game gives you weapons that are only triggered by certain letters. This has to be balanced very well for the game to maintain its design integrity. We have found a workaround using romaji that we hope will be acceptable to Japanese players. If so, then we may end up using this system for other non-roman alphabet languages.

Version: v2024.04.26.001-ALPHA

Bugfixes
---------
- Fixed Tesla Mines not doing damage or targeting enemies within range.
- Fixed bug where typing the wrong word in upgrade/loot menu sometimes unpauses the game in the background.
- Fixed "Precision" loot item giving 20% crit chance instead of 2% like stated in description.
- Fixed crash due to negative weights when randomizing loot.
- Fixed crash due to log file prevented from being saved by antivirus software or similar.
- Fixed icon of Blade Trap not reflecting actual Blade Trap.

Balancing
----------
- Added adaptive difficulty to provide a bit more challenge to better players.
- Nerfed Hunter duration upgrades from 20% to 10%.
- Nerfed Spectre damage upgrades from 20% to 15%.
- Nerfed Spectre duration upgrades from 20% to 10%.
- Removed double word in early game, now they only start spawning if you pick an upgrade that adds double word chance.
- Make longer word chance force 8-character words instead of just increasing word length by 2.

New Features
--------------
- Added Japanese localization and wordlist (experimental)
- Level up is now triggered by spacebar / right-stick-down so as not to disrupt typing flow.
- Added windowed / fullscreen option.
- If enemy is destroyed while typing its word, the word will remain until it is completed or there is a mistype. Weapons will trigger on word complete normally.
- Added pause menu.
- Escape key now also closes weapon details panel.
- Hide words when game is paused to prevent abuse.

notes.title: Visual Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VJTtvw6.gif[/img]

After receiving a lot of feedback from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/roguelites/comments/1b8idrt/looking_for_honest_feedback_would_you_play_a_game/]Reddit[/url], we've made some minor adjustments to the visuals of the game for better readability and clarity.

We've added a spot of color to enemies so you can easily tell them from the projectiles and power-ups, increased font sizes, and boosted contrast. You can turn off the colored enemies in the options if the original monochromatic look is more your style.

As usual, we're always listening to feedback, and we aim to do this even more when our demo is released in about a months time! Stay tuned!
